principle: Aws-us claude session subprocess does not commit + push automatically. Mac orchestrator must monitor + manual commit + push.
context: During sprint round 9 phase B, three aws-us Pattern-A sessions (RSI, MLS, DAO) all wrote files to the worktree but did not run `git commit + push` from inside `claude -p`. Output went to /tmp/claude-*.log which stayed at 0 bytes because claude -p uses tool calls (Write/Edit) without final text output. The Mac orchestrator manually `git -c user.email=aws-us@sisoul commit + git push origin <branch>` to finish the cycle. Pattern: claude -p in non-interactive mode does the file edits but not the git workflow. Solution: orchestrator monitors `ls worktree/ + git status` and finishes the cycle.
